column3: Description
Welcome the team.
Introduce the sprint and set the right mindset.
Define the most important customer for your solution.
Identify the most critical problem to solve for your target customer.
Step away, refresh, and recharge.
List the unique skills, expertise, or technologies your team possesses to solve the problem.
Identify the unique knowledge, experience, or understanding that gives your team an edge.
Define the passions or internal drivers that push your team to solve this problem.
Identify direct competitors, substitutes, and the "800-pound gorilla" in the market.
Summarize the target customer, their problem, the team advantages, and competitors on the Basics map.
Take a longer break before the afternoon session.
Explore how your solution compares using common differentiators (fast, easy, affordable, etc.).
Generate bold, unique ways your solution stands out from competitors.
Review all custom differentiators and vote on their impact and feasibility.
Vote on and finalize the differentiators to pursue.
Step away, refresh, and recharge.
Plot competitors and your solution based on key differentiators.
Brainstorm the fundamental beliefs that will guide your team’s decisions and behaviors.
Draft actionable principles that help the team stay aligned with their values during decisions.
Summarize the key insights in Mini Manifesto and close the session.
Description
Welcome the team back again.
Ideate multiple approaches to solve the problem.
Develop brief one-page summaries for each approach, including title, description, and sketch.
Take a short pause before evaluation.
Review all one-page summaries and use heatmap voting to highlight favorite elements.
Identify key criteria (e.g., cost, effort, risk, scalability) for each approach.
Use the customer, pragmatic, growth, and money lenses to compare approaches.
Take a longer break before the afternoon session.
Use the customer, pragmatic, growth, and money lenses to compare approaches.
Revisit the team's selected criteria and align on which matter most for final selection.
Compare approaches using the custom lenses designed based on team-specific priorities.
Take a short pause before evaluation.
Test each approach against the differentiators defined on Day 1 to ensure alignment.
Review all charts and let the decider choose the final approach and a backup plan.
Summarize all key decisions in one clear statement.
